manifest.name: dsh-inkpond
manifest.description: Interactive Chinese ink-wash backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness: lotus pond, misty hills, Qingming handscroll, 24 solar terms, Northern sea and Big fat whale.
manifest.author: Shin

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md)

以字为墨，以页为池。为 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面铺一层可交互的汉字水墨背景。

默认是**大肥鲸**：圆滚滚的鲸鱼在汉字海浪中游动，会游向饭碗吃饭、喷米，并响应指针互动。
可切换莲池、山水、清明上河、二十四节气和北冥，保留输入区留白、明暗主题跟随及自动性能降级。

[查看大图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shin4/inkpond-dsh/main/docs/images/whale-preview.png) · macOS、DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 Web 实录，默认大肥鲸、45% 浓度；另有[莲池演示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shin4/inkpond-dsh/main/docs/images/lotus-preview.gif)。

1. 在 DSH 打开 **插件 → 添加插件**。
2. 填入 **`dsh-inkpond@0.3.5`**，选择 **npm 官方源**，点击安装；若宿主提示重启，按提示重启。
3. **新建空白会话**，即可看到默认大肥鲸。默认仅新会话显示；已有保存偏好的客户端保留原选择。

Web profile 也可使用命令：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-inkpond@0.3.5
```

无需下载源码或本机编译。不读取聊天内容，不注册模型工具，不发送遥测。完整安装方式与兼容性范围见下文。

安装要求为 **DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3**，不设上限，后续 rc 和正式版不会因精确版本锁定而被拒绝。
背景功能已实测 **0.2.1-rc.3、0.2.1-rc.5 和 0.2.2-rc.1**（macOS，隔离 Web profile）；本次设置页改版在 **0.2.2-rc.1** 验证。
更新入口另在 **0.2.2-alpha.2** 隔离宿主验收；这些预发布版本不改变最低安装要求。其他版本、原生桌面壳及 Windows/Linux 尚未验证。
允许安装不等于已验证兼容。插件依赖会话容器的语义 DOM 标记；未知布局不会挂载背景，宿主 API 或布局变更仍可能需要适配。

设置页提供手动更新入口。支持宿主原生 `listVersions` / `updateBundle` 时，点击“检查更新”查找可用的稳定版本，显示当前与目标版本；确认后由 DSH 安装明确版本，并显示完成、重启或恢复结果。
不会自动检查或静默升级。检查请求在页面卸载时取消；自更新可能重新载入设置页，请在原生插件管理中确认最终版本。

DSH rc.5 等不支持这些接口的宿主显示手动更新说明和“插件管理”入口；从本地安装包、Git 或链接安装的插件按宿主能力降级为原生管理。外观偏好保留。
客户端只调用宿主更新接口，不直接访问 npm、不自行下载或卸载。检查失败不会显示为“已是最新”。

此入口从 **0.3.3** 提供。发布状态见 [发布记录](docs/release.md)。

设置页底部高亮显示「喜欢墨池？点个 Star」，点击「Star on GitHub」会在新页面打开仓库。
该入口只是普通链接，不自动请求 GitHub，也不读取或修改 Star 状态。

本版 **0.3.5** 改进设置页布局与文案，兼容性要求仍为 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3，默认大肥鲸。
**0.3.5 已发布至 npm 和 GitHub Releases**；详见 [发布记录](docs/release.md)。可按下方方式安装明确版本。

readme.section: 桌面版或网页版：通过添加插件向导安装（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 打开 DSH 的 **插件 → 添加插件**（Add plugin）。
2. 在向导的「包名或地址」输入框中填写 npm 包名：

```text
   dsh-inkpond
   ```

如需固定版本，填写 `dsh-inkpond@0.3.5`。
3. 在「安装源」中选择 **npm 官方源**，点击 **安装**（Install）。新版本可能尚未同步到镜像源。
4. 安装后新建空白会话，首次安装即可看到默认大肥鲸；已有保存偏好的客户端会保留原选择。若宿主提示重启，请完全退出并重新打开 DSH。

pnpm 11 默认避开发布未满 24 小时的版本。新版本发布当天，即使选择官方源，裸包名也可能选回旧版；请显式填写 `dsh-inkpond@0.3.5`。

此入口直接从 npm 安装，不依赖 1024 Store 或 dshmarket 是否已收录。
无需下载源码或在本机编译。适用版本仍以本文的兼容性说明为准。

readme.section: 使用 CLI 安装到 Web profile
readme.text:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-inkpond@0.3.5
```

桌面版推荐使用上述应用内向导，它会安装到当前应用的 profile；
不要假定终端的 `web` profile 就是桌面配置。包发布于 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-inkpond)。

从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/shin4/inkpond-dsh/releases/tag/v0.3.5) 下载 `dsh-inkpond-0.3.5.tgz`。
在 DSH 插件管理页填入本地安装包的绝对路径，或使用普通 Web profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-inkpond-0.3.5.tgz
```

从 0.1.0 升级时，按宿主提示先卸载旧插件，再安装 0.3.5 安装包。外观偏好会保留。
刷新页面；若宿主未热加载，重启对应实例。安装包包含构建产物，不执行安装期编译。
GitHub 源码 checkout 需要先 `npm ci && npm run build`，不能直接从未构建源码安装。

插件 → 已安装 → dsh-inkpond（以下为 0.3.5 行为）：

已有客户端保存的场景选择会保留；无保存偏好的客户端和“恢复默认”使用大肥鲸。

- 默认大肥鲸，亦可选莲池、山水、清明上河、二十四节气和北冥。节气随当前日期选择画面；北冥呈现海浪与鲸影；大肥鲸会游向饭碗吃饭、喷米，并响应指针互动。
- 默认仅新会话显示；可选择所有会话（长对话兼容性仍需更多实测）。
- 调整淡彩、墨色浓淡，选择跟随系统动画或静态画面。
- 恢复默认会回到大肥鲸、45% 浓度、仅新会话、跟随系统动画。

画布不会接管点击、键盘或发送消息。关闭标签页显示会暂停，减少动画设置会生成静态画面，
高对比度模式会隐藏画布。弱设备会自动降低动画档位。

外观偏好存于当前客户端 origin 的 `localStorage`（`dsh-inkpond.preferences.v1`），
性能档位使用 `dsh-inkpond.tier.v1`。它们不跨浏览器、端口或设备同步。
存储不可用时设置仅在当前页面有效。卸载会清除运行实例、样式与 DOM 标记，保留本地偏好便于重装；
需要彻底清除偏好时可删除上述两个站点存储键。

Node.js 22+，npm：

```bash
npm ci
npm run check
npm pack
```

`check` 执行类型检查、单元测试和构建。`npm pack` 生成独立安装包，包含 Host 入口、
DSH 客户端工厂、内嵌字体和许可证。React 由宿主提供，绘制引擎固定使用 本地 inkpond 提交 `4cb32fb1ef9120d4115e47265ad13a13c7fb59f6`（独立依赖包，详见 `vendor/README.md`）。

使用独立 `DSH_HOME` 验证安装包；不要在日常 profile 中进行卸载测试。
已观察到 DSH 本地链接卸载可能清理链接目标的开发依赖，因此推荐始终用 `.tgz` 做安装验收。

详见 [验证记录](docs/verification.md) 和 [发布清单](docs/release.md)。

本插件提供背景、外观设置和宿主更新入口，不注册模型工具，不读取消息或发送遥测。
客户端不直接访问外部服务；用户触发更新检查或升级时，由 DSH 宿主访问包源并执行安装。
六个字体子集随包提供，无需 CDN。宿主自身的网络行为不由本插件控制。

代码采用 MIT；绘制核心来自 [inkpond](https://github.com/shin4/inkpond)，
字体采用 SIL OFL 1.1，见 [第三方声明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。
独立社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

[简体中文](README.md)

Interactive Chinese glyph ink-wash backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness.
The default **Big fat whale** swims through glyph waves, eats rice, spouts grains and reacts to the pointer.
Lotus pond, Misty hills, a Qingming handscroll, the 24 solar terms and the Northern sea are also included.

[View the full-size screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shin4/inkpond-dsh/main/docs/images/whale-preview.png) · Actual capture on macOS, DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 Web, with the default Big fat whale and 45% strength. See also the [Lotus pond demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shin4/inkpond-dsh/main/docs/images/lotus-preview.gif).

1. In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin**.
2. Enter **`dsh-inkpond@0.3.5`**, select the **Official npm registry**, and install. Restart if the host requests it.
3. **Start a new empty conversation** to see the default Big fat whale. It appears only in new conversations by default; existing saved preferences are preserved.

For a Web profile, you can also run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-inkpond@0.3.5
```
No source checkout or local compilation is needed. Inkpond does not read chat contents, register model tools or send telemetry. Full installation instructions and compatibility limits follow below.

Installation requires **DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3**, with no upper bound, so later prereleases and
stable releases are not rejected by an exact version pin. Actually tested hosts are
**0.2.1-rc.3, 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1** on macOS in isolated Web profiles for backgrounds.
This settings redesign was verified in **0.2.2-rc.1**. The update entry was also tested in isolated **0.2.2-alpha.2**;
these prereleases do not change the minimum installation requirement. Other versions, native desktop shells and Windows/Linux remain unverified. Installation eligibility does not imply verified compatibility.
The adapter uses semantic conversation DOM markers and leaves unknown layouts untouched;
host API/layout changes may still require updates.

The settings page provides a manual update entry. When the Host exposes native `listVersions` / `updateBundle`, Check for updates finds an eligible stable version and shows the installed and target versions. After confirmation, DSH installs that exact version and reports completion, a required restart, or recovery.
No automatic checks or silent upgrades run. Leaving the page cancels its check; self-update may reload settings, so confirm the final version in native Plugins.

Hosts such as DSH rc.5 show manual update instructions and a Plugins entry. Tarball, Git and linked installations fall back to native management according to Host support. Appearance preferences are retained.
The Client only calls Host update APIs; it does not contact npm, download packages or uninstall itself. A failed check is never reported as up to date.

This entry is available from **0.3.3**. See the [release record](docs/release.md) for publication status.

The settings footer highlights “Enjoy Inkpond? Give it a Star”. Clicking “Star on GitHub” opens the repository in a new page.
This is a regular link: it does not automatically request GitHub or read or change Star status.

**0.3.5** improves the settings layout and copy. DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 and the Big fat whale default are unchanged.
**0.3.5 is published on npm and GitHub Releases**; see the [release record](docs/release.md). Install an exact version using the instructions below.

readme.section: Desktop or Web: use the Add plugin wizard (recommended)
readme.text:
1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in DSH.
2. Enter the npm package name in the **Package name or address** field:

```text
   dsh-inkpond
   ```

readme.section: Desktop or Web: use the Add plugin wizard (recommended)
readme.text:
To pin this version, enter `dsh-inkpond@0.3.5`.
3. Select **Official npm registry** under the installation registry options, then click **Install**.
   Mirrors may not have synchronized a newly published version yet.
4. Start a new empty conversation to see Big fat whale on a fresh install; existing saved scene choices are preserved. If DSH requests a restart,
   fully quit and reopen the application.

readme.section: Desktop or Web: use the Add plugin wizard (recommended)
readme.text:
pnpm 11 defaults to avoiding versions published less than 24 hours ago. On release day, a bare package name can select an older version even from the official registry; enter `dsh-inkpond@0.3.5` explicitly.

The wizard installs directly from npm, independently of listings in 1024 Store or dshmarket.
No source checkout or local compilation is needed. The compatibility limits above still apply.

readme.section: Install into a Web profile with the CLI
readme.text:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-inkpond@0.3.5
```

For Desktop, prefer the in-app wizard above, which targets the current application's profile.
The terminal's `web` profile is not necessarily the Desktop profile.
The package is published on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-inkpond).

Download `dsh-inkpond-0.3.5.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/shin4/inkpond-dsh/releases/tag/v0.3.5).
Enter its absolute local path in the host plugin manager, or install into a regular Web profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-inkpond-0.3.5.tgz
```

When upgrading from 0.1.0, follow the host prompt to uninstall the old plugin, then install the 0.3.5 tarball. Appearance preferences are retained.
Refresh the page; restart the instance if it does not hot-load. The tarball is prebuilt and
does not compile code at installation time.
A GitHub source checkout requires `npm ci && npm run build` before installation.
The following describes 0.3.5. Existing saved scene choices are preserved; clients without saved preferences and Restore defaults use Big fat whale.

Open Plugins → Installed → dsh-inkpond. Select Lotus pond, Misty hills, Qingming handscroll, 24 solar terms (selected by the current date), Northern sea (waves and a whale) or Big fat whale (default; eating rice, spouting grains and reacting to the pointer);
choose new conversations only (default) or all conversations, toggle color accents, adjust ink strength,
and select system animation preferences or a still image. All-conversation mode needs further long-chat testing.
Restore defaults returns to Big fat whale, 45% strength, new conversations only and system motion preferences.

The canvas passes through clicks and never controls typing or sending. Hidden pages pause animation;
reduced motion produces a still image, and forced colors hides the decoration. Weak devices downgrade automatically.

Preferences use this client's origin-local storage (`dsh-inkpond.preferences.v1`); performance uses
`dsh-inkpond.tier.v1`. They do not synchronize between browsers, ports or devices. When storage is
unavailable, changes last only for the current page. Uninstall removes runtime instances, styles and DOM
markers but retains preferences for reinstall. Delete those two storage keys to remove preferences too.

`check` runs type checking, tests and the build. The tarball contains the Host entry, DSH client factory,
offline fonts and licenses. React comes from DSH; the renderer is pinned to local inkpond commit `4cb32fb1ef9120d4115e47265ad13a13c7fb59f6`
(an independent dependency tarball; see `vendor/README.md`).
Test tarballs in a separate `DSH_HOME`. Avoid uninstall tests in a daily profile. DSH local-link removal
was observed cleaning the linked target's development dependencies, so use tarballs for acceptance testing.
See the [verification record](docs/verification.md) and [release checklist](docs/release.md).

This plugin provides backgrounds, appearance preferences and a Host update entry. It registers no model tools,
reads no messages and sends no telemetry. The Client does not contact external services directly;
when the user checks or confirms an update, the DSH Host contacts the package registry and performs installation. All fonts are included; no CDN
is needed. The host's own networking is outside this plugin's control.

MIT code; renderer from [inkpond](https://github.com/shin4/inkpond). Font subsets use SIL OFL 1.1;
see [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Independent community project, unaffiliated with DeepSeek.
